==About==

Crafting a {{i|Sea Loaf}} will make an {{i|Unboiled Sea Loaf}} which can then be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} for 30 minutes to produce a Sea Loaf.
